title: Machine-Certified Lean 4 Formalization of the General Divisor Theorem: Unified Density, Arbitrary-Bound Counting, and Finite Error Bounds
description: Exhaustive machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the General Divisor Theorem (GDT) across 7 production modules (81 kernel-checked theorems and lemmas, 0 custom axioms, 0 sorry, 0 native_decide). Proves the exact arithmetic dichotomy (inadmissible empty branch for gcd(|a|, d) > 1 vs admissible periodic branch for gcd(|a|, d) = 1), minimal period T_min = lcm(m, rad(N)), exact single-period count #{0 <= n < T_min : n === a (mod m), gcd(n, N) = 1} = phi(R) via affine units over ZMod R, closed-form arbitrary-bound counting C(q*T_min + s) = q*phi(R) + C(s) in O(1) arithmetic steps, finite error bound |T_min C(X) - phi(R)X| <= T_min^2, and natural density convergence delta(S) = phi(R)/(mR) via real squeeze theorem. Includes two-way cross-validation bridges and 2,287 automated Python verification sweeps with a 100% pass rate.
